ChangeRequest.name: AE Requirements - High liquidity and credit quality (HQLA) indicator - (HQLA_INDCTR)
ChangeRequest.comment:
Currently in the LDM there's an entity _High liquidity and credit quality (HQLA) type_, with attribute `High liquidity and credit quality (HQLA) indicator`, related only to the entity _Security_.
In AE this concept is used in templates F 32.01, F 32.02.a/b, F 32.03.b and it is needed/relevant for loans and advances, equity instruments that are securities, debt securities (both negotiable and not negotiable) and, among other assets, cash on hand.
